session.checkpoint_state: All exposed node voltages, seven relay coil currents, external sweep epoch, controls and operator bookkeeping; Gear history restarts.

session.worker_recycle: Validate-then-commit at a safe pulse boundary every 0.5 s or above heap threshold. An initial-point rejection retains the old solver and consumes pending input once; retry after 0.05 s.
